description: Return the worst peak-to-trough decline of each currency vs `base`, with peak, trough, and recovery dates/days. Use for "how far did it fall and did it recover" questions or to rank the deepest drawdowns. Omit `currency` to rank the universe (`sort` deepest or recovery); provide one currency or a list to compare. Use `analyze_volatility` for dispersion and `analyze_safe_haven` for crisis behaviour. Defaults: 365-day window, `base` USD, `sort` deepest, `universe` liquid, `limit` 10. Returns `{ base, from, to, mode, results[] }`; peak/trough dates are omitted and recovery fields are null when there is no drawdown or recovery in the window. Requires a signed-in connection and the Growth plan or higher; each successful call bills 1 API request.

base.description: Base currency to measure against (3-letter ISO 4217). Defaults to USD.

currency.description: Currency to measure (3-letter ISO 4217), or a comma-separated list. OMIT to RANK the liquid set by drawdown.

from.description: Window start YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to 365 days before `to`.

limit.description: Ranking: how many to return (default 10, max 50).

sort.description: Ranking direction: deepest (largest decline first, default) or recovery (fastest recovery first).

to.description: Window end YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today.

name: analyze_drawdown
title: Drawdown analysis
